data.title: search misses the last word of every sentence
data.description: Found while testing the prompt hook (KAD-53): tokenize() keeps . inside a token so state.json and KAD-42 survive, but that also keeps the full stop, so a sentence ending in 'steps.' indexes 'steps.' and a query for 'steps' never matches it. Reproduced on a scratch repo: note 'Rollback needs the release steps.' - search 'steps' 0 hits, 'steps.' 1 hit. Fix: trim trailing . - _ from a token, keep them inside it. Ranking moves, so the golden set is re-run and timing re-measured.
